'''Lunae Minx''' was a [[Color|purple]]-skinned [[Twi'lek]] that visited the [[Outlander Club]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY]]. While stood at a table with the [[Slavery|enslaved]] Twi'lek [[Ayy Vida]] and the conman [[Achk Med-Beq]], Minx's attention was drawn to the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] while he searched for the [[bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]].

==Biography==
[[File:MinxAndMed-Beq-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|Lunae Minx was a patron of the Outlander Club.]]
Lunae Minx<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga">{{SW|url=news/die-wanna-wanga-encounters-of-the-twilek-kind|text=Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind|nolive=1}}</ref> was [[Twi'lek]] that visited<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Outlander Club]] in [[Uscru Entertainment District]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="HC39" /> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[22 BBY]].</ref> While at the club, Minx was befriended by the fellow Twi'lek [[Ayy Vida]], who was [[Slavery|enslaved]] by the [[crime lord]] [[Hat Lo]] and hoped that someone would free her from Lo.<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" />

Minx, Vida and the [[human]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Achk Med-Beq]], a conman dressed as a member of the [[Republic Security Force]],<ref name="HC39">{{HelmetCollectionCite|39|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> stood at a table when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] entered the club in search of the fleeing [[bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]]. Skywalker passed by the Minx's table and gestured toward the trio stood there, drawing both Minx and Med-Beq's attention as he passed to continue the search. Minx watched Skywalker again when he approached the table for a second [[time]], shortly after which Wesell was cut down by Kenobi after attempting to attack him at the club's bar. With drinks in hand, Minx, Vida, and Med-Beq turned their attention to the incident with the rest of the club's patrons, causing Skywalker to dismiss their interest by declaring the event "[[Jedi]] business" before he and Kenobi dragged the wounded bounty hunter outside.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Lunae Minx had mottled [[Color|purple]] skin and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Equipment==
While at the Outlander Club, Minx wore a black [[Clothing|dress]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|And for the second movie, I designed my outfit with Trisha's help. They showed me pictures and because my character would be in a nightclub, I wanted something a bit sexy.|Katie Lucas|<ref name="Katie Lucas">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20051221/index.html|text=The Force Runs Strong In This Family: Jett, Amanda & Katie}}</ref>}}
[[File:KatieLucas.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lunae Minx was portrayed by Katie Lucas.]]
Lunae Minx appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="AOTC" /> in which the character was portrayed by [[Katie Lucas]], daughter of director [[George Lucas]]. After seeing pictures, Katie designed her costume for the film with the help of costume designer [[Trisha Biggar]], wanting something slightly sexy to wear at the club. The makeup for the costume took almost six hours and included coloring all down the arms, with spots airbrushed onto the Twi'lek's [[lekku]]. To account for this, Katie's call time was three am, with make up taking till around seven and then shooting starting two hours after that<ref name="Katie Lucas" /> on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Minx's name was confirmed by the article "Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind", written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[August 19]], [[2014]] and was later reconfirmed by<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1486536476993077248|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-27|quote=Katie Lucas as the purple Twi'lek Lunae Minx here. She's hanging with @ahmedbest as Achk-Med Bek.|archivedate=20220127031318}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member<ref name="SW Show Interview">{{StarWarsShow|GvT2F1j-SvA|Pablo Hidalgo Extended Interview|sw_url=video/pablo-hidalgo-extended-interview}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] on [[January 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="Twitter" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] in entries for [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Vida]] and [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Med-Beq]]<ref name="Med-Beq">{{DB|character|achkmedbeq|Med-Beq, Achk}}</ref><ref name="Vida">{{DB|character|ayyvida|Vida, Ayy}}</ref> posted in 2002.<ref name="Coruscant Nightlife">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/06/news20020614.html|text=Coruscant Nightlife}}</ref> The names for Minx and many of the other extras were created by George Lucas and [[Lucasfilm]] shortly after the scenes were shot in anticipation of spin-off fiction or licensing possibilites.<ref name="Aliases">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> Minx was also at one point known by fans as "Nabrina Smoo."<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" />
